question: In a certain code language, ‘HIGHLY’ is written as ‘GRHYOH’ and 'CLEVER' is written as 'EOCRVV'. How will ‘HORROR’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'HIGHLY’ is written as ‘GRHYOH',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a683a55c5e8fb43bdff7f7c70afc7c005ba5a844455c3dc3f4a18cd1f1634db9.png] 

‘CLEVER' is written as 'EOCRVV’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36a6486d5622e8947ce8542f0e248d1b45dd89732ff00a27c986f61e7c2c45e2.png] 

Similarly, for '**HORROR**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43faf8a38c761949eacf2d7d61862055127ebb428415c8a4ecf5b812b6347cde.png] 

So, 'HORROR' will be written as '**RLHRLR**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
